changelog:
- Improved Feishu chat responsiveness by spawning background child tasks for substantial user requests.
- Ensured each major prompt creates its own independent background task, keeping the foreground chat available for new prompts.
- Added clear guidance for when to spawn child tasks, agent selection, and recommended acknowledgement patterns in user replies.
- Outlined handling for progress updates, task completion, and user status queries.
- Specified best practices for labeling spawned tasks for easier tracking and improved user experience.
